name: Kobold Wizard (Kobold Adept 3)
body:
Kobold Adept
CR 1 (XP 400)

Male kobold adept 3
LE Small humanoid (reptilian)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 10 (3d6)
Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5
Weakness light sensitivity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork club +3 (1d3)
Spells Prepared (CL 3rd)

1st–burning hands (DC 13), cause fear (DC 13), command (DC 13)

TACTICS

During Combat He casts spells and shies away from melee.

Morale He surrenders if reduced to 5 hit points or less.

Str 10, Dex 13, Con 11, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 12
Base Atk +1; CMB +0; CMD 11

Skills Craft (trapmaking) +2, Perception +5, Profession (miner) +2, Sense Motive +2, Spellcraft +6, Stealth +9, Survival +6; Racial Modifiers +2 Craft (trapmaking), +2 Perception, +2 Profession (miner)
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ summon familiar (bat named)
Gear masterwork club, torn brown robes, oversized dwarven boots

Bat Familiar

Female bat familiar
N Diminutive animal
Init +2; Senses blindsense 20 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 16, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +4 size)
hp 2 (1d8–2)
Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 5 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)
Melee bite +6 (1d3–4)

Racial Modifier +4 Perception
